subject: Onboarding: index backfill prioritization, cold-start quotas & rerank smoke tests
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@searchly.com>, Searchly Onboarding <onboarding@searchly.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 May 2025 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding: index backfill prioritization, cold-start quotas & rerank smoke tests

Hi Alex / team,

Thanks again for choosing Redwood — excited to get Searchly live. I wanted to surface a compact plan for the embedding/rerank onboarding so we can align on priorities before the kickoff:

- Index backfill windows: we recommend 3 waves (hot, warm, cold) to avoid load spikes. We should agree a daily token cap for wave 1 (hot) to keep latency SLOs intact.
- Cold-start quotas: Searchly indicated a large historical index; we'll need quota uplift for the first 48–72 hours of the hot wave. Please confirm expected documents/day.
- Vectorstore tiering: propose using hot SSD instances for recent/top-ranked docs and warm HDD-backed pools for archival content — reduces cost while keeping rerank quality for current queries.
- Rerank smoke tests: plan attached (rerank_smoke_test_plan.md). Acceptance: 10k sampled queries, baseline precision delta <= 2% for top-5, latency P95 within agreed SLO.

Can you confirm: (a) expected daily backfill ingestion rate, (b) any embargoed datasets (PII/compliance), and (c) preferred time windows for heavy backfill (UTC)? Once we have that I'll send an internal handoff note to our implementation team.

Attachments: searchly_index_map.csv (index -> collection mapping), rerank_smoke_test_plan.md

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai
+1 415 555 0142

From: Alex Johnson <alex.j@searchly.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 May 2025 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: index backfill prioritization, cold-start quotas & rerank smoke tests

Hi Irene — thanks for the clear plan. Quick answers below: 

- Expected backfill: ~2.2M documents total. We can smooth to ~200k docs/day for the hot wave if that helps.
- No embargoed datasets but the customer dataset includes hashed PII fields we treat as sensitive (we'll flag any surprises during ingestion).
- Preferred windows: weekday nights (01:00–06:00 UTC) for bulk loads; we can run canary loads during day for smoke tests.

We'll need a temporary quota bump for the initial 72 hours — can your team open that request? Also looping in onboarding@searchly.com to coordinate our side.

Cheers,
Alex Johnson
Head of Search Platform, Searchly Inc.
alex.j@searchly.com
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Johnson <alex.j@searchly.com>
Date: Mon, 5 May 2025 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Onboarding: index backfill prioritization, cold-start quotas & rerank smoke tests

Team — forwarding Searchly answers. Action items for implementation and infra below. Please treat this as the official handoff + first cut of the rollout timeline.

High-level constraints from customer:
- Total documents: ~2.2M
- Hot wave target: up to 200k docs/day (prefer UTC night window)
- Sensitive fields: hashed PII (no full replacement; treat as sensitive)

Implementation action list (owner -> task):
1) Jordan -> quota uplift request for 72 hours + burst policy; include metric thresholds and rollback plan. (Due: 5/6)
2) Marissa -> ingestion template + sample mapping validation against searchly_index_map.csv. Check tokenizer/embedding pipeline compatibility. (Due: 5/6)
3) Jordan -> vectorstore tiering config: map collections -> hot/warm buckets, estimate cost delta. (Due: 5/7)
4) Marissa -> define rerank smoke test harness and sampling plan per attached md. (Due: 5/7)
5) Irene -> coordinate canary schedule with Searchly and lock nightly backfill windows. (Due: 5/6)

Notes: prioritize safety — if latency or error rates spike above thresholds, we throttle the backfill and spin up additional hot nodes. For sensitive fields, use encryption-at-rest and audit logging — legal will need a quick glance but customer said hashed PII is okay.

Let me know if anything needs reassigning.

Thanks,
Irene

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 7 May 2025 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Onboarding: index backfill prioritization, cold-start quotas & rerank smoke tests

Quick status update + clarifications from infra: 

- Quota uplift: raised a temporary 2x quota for hot tier, valid 72 hours starting at 2025-05-09T01:00:00Z (aligned to the customer's requested nightly window). Ticket ID: INF-78421. I'll post the link in the hub once confirmed.
- Vectorstore tiering: initial plan attached in-line. We'll allocate 3 hot SSD shards for the top 20% of traffic collections (estimated 450k vectors) and place the remainder in warm nodes with an async fallback to hot via our prefix cache. Estimated incremental cost: +18% for the first month.
- Rerank smoke tests: Marissa and I reviewed the plan. We'll run a 10k-query canary split across two models (prod and candidate) and measure top-5 precision and P95 latency. If precision delta > 2% or latency P95 > 200ms difference, we block.

Open question for legal/security: do we need an NDA addendum for audit log retention beyond 90 days? Alex — can you confirm retention needs?

Tagging owners: @Marissa please confirm ingestion template is ready by EOD 5/7.

-Jordan
Jordan Blake
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Alex Johnson <alex.j@searchly.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Searchly Onboarding <onboarding@searchly.com>
Date: Wed, 7 May 2025 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Onboarding: index backfill prioritization, cold-start quotas & rerank smoke tests

Thanks everyone — that all looks good to me. A few clarifications:

- NDA/retention: Searchly is okay with 90-day audit logs for now. If we need longer for any compliance review we'll escalate.
- Cost: the incremental cost estimate is within our budget for month 1; we may revisit tiering after the initial cutover.
- Canary schedule: start canary on 2025-05-09 at 02:00 UTC with a 5k query sample, then if green proceed to the hot wave the same night.

I'll mark permissions for the ingestion service and send the sample CSV tonight. Appreciate the quick coordination.

--
Alex Johnson
Head of Search Platform, Searchly Inc.
